inForce.howVerified: Statutory Notice of Designation (dated 3 December 2021) records Secretary of State confirmation on 30 November 2021 that the designations come into force 1 April 2022 and cease 31 March 2027, and the live durham.gov.uk/selectivelicensing page body states the same dates and that licences last until 31 March 2027.

schemes.boundaryDescription: The designations shall apply to the following Lower Super Output Areas of the County Council of Durham and as shown shaded on the map attached to this notice at Annex A. Designation One: 26 LSOAs; Designation Two: 5 LSOAs; Designation Three: 46 LSOAs; Designation Four: 26 LSOAs (103 LSOAs in total, listed in areaNames). The designation is defined by whole Lower Super Output Area boundaries, not by street. The council publishes no street list. The following 21 postcodes straddle a designation boundary and the council directs enquirers to email selectivelicensing@durham.gov.uk rather than giving a yes/no: DH2 2DP, DH8 5HQ, DH8 7PQ, DH8 7UB, DH8 7UE, DH8 8DQ, DH9 6HN, DH9 6SA, DH9 8HL, DH9 8HU, DL13 3JH, DL14 7BA, DL14 9EW, DL15 8JJ, DL15 8QF, DL16 7BW, DL16 7FA, DL16 7UW, DL17 8ER, DL17 8JP, SR7 7RS.
schemes.evidence: Postcodes transcribed from the council's own "Selective licensing postcode list" CSV (https://www.durham.gov.uk/media/40646/Selective-licensing-postcode-list/csv/PostcodeList.csv), linked from durham.gov.uk/selectivelicensing under "Selective licensing areas ... please use our property checker"; the 4,296 postcodes marked "Included" are listed, and the 21 marked "Please email selectivelicensing@durham.gov.uk" (boundary-split) are excluded from postcodes and recorded in boundaryDescription instead. The CSV was cross-checked row-by-row against the council's parallel PostcodeChecker.xlsx: the two agree on Included/email status for every shared postcode; the CSV is the newer file (3 extra postcodes, 4 refreshed settlement labels). The 103 areaNames are transcribed from the statutory "Notice of Designation of an area for Selective Licensing" PDF (The County Council of Durham Designations of Areas for Selective Licensing 2021, dated 3 December 2021, signed Helen Lynch, Head of Legal & Democratic Services), extracted twice (pdftotext -layout and pypdf) with identical results, and they match the CSV's 103 distinct LSOA names exactly apart from three council abbreviations (Midridge/Middridge South, Murton Moor & Sth/South Hetton, Woodham Village SW/South West) - the notice spellings are used here. Currency: the notice states the Secretary of State confirmed on 30 November 2021 that the designations come into force 1 April 2022 and cease five years later on 31 March 2027, and the live page body repeats "came into effect on 1 April 2022 and will expire on 31 March 2027", so the scheme is in force on 7 August 2026. No street list is published by the council; the designation is drawn on whole LSOA boundaries.
